changes.summary: Background public-release checks and dashboard notices, with opt-out preferences, ETag caching, backoff, seven languages and optional alert connectors.
Discovery never grants upgrade authority or uploads customer credentials. Vault probes disable discovery; restored retry timestamps cannot overflow into rapid polling.
Native upgrade and recovery compatibility includes the published v2.11.7 and v2.12.0 baselines with preserved configuration, business keys and management sessions.
